There’s Something Special in a Gumiho’s Liver

description:
A female student is enrolled in a school that is actually a secret hideout for nine tailed demon foxes.

On her first day of school, Yu-eun, who was wandering around the street because she couldn’t find her school, encountered a boy named Seo Il-hoo, who is actually a nine tailed fox Gumiho. She has no idea that this is what’s happening, but Sunwoon High School is actually a dangerous school full of Gumiho. The ratio of all school students is 10 percent Gumiho, and 90 percent humans. The foxes were using this method as a way to remove their traces from the exorcist who was tracking them down, so they mixed themselves up among humans and pretended to be ordinary students. The so-called Sunwoon High School is a perfect hiding place for Gumiho and a perfect place to easily hunt for the human spirit.

Seo Il-hoo, who finds out that Yu-eun is a human being but has the ability to see the them for who they are, puts her under his control and goes in for the hunt of her spirit. While there is a strange atmosphere between Il-hoo and Tae-shin surrounding Yu-eun, Baek-ryeon, the chairman of the board who brought Yu-eun to the school, tries to use Yu-eun, who turns out to be the great-granddaughter of the leader of the exorcist Jeong-ju, who was the only one who stood by and protected the Gumiho.
